methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: In total, 16 technological combinations are considered, and three models are established for different sets of efficiency indicators: energy performance indicator, energy performance indicator with undesirable output, and total performance indicator.

paper_type.evidence_quote: this paper aims to propose an analytical framework combining an enhanced DEA method with the LCA to evaluate a group of energy-saving technological routes for the complete supply chain for the aluminum industry in China.
